roster.name: Wry

allies.name: Fuse Bug
allies.blurb: Sparks once, then crawls into the panel.

allies.name: Meter Shield
allies.blurb: Glass and steel — blocks the next swing.

allies.name: Bulkhead
allies.blurb: Moves like a wall that got angry.

allies.name: Floor Plan
allies.blurb: Marks the safe path in pencil.

rattle-hatch.name: Rattle Hatch
rattle-hatch.blurb: Loose hatch plate with teeth. Small pack.
rattle-hatch.intent: Strikes a random ally — or a hero if the board is empty.
rattle-hatch.winText: The plate stops rattling. Side tunnel clear.
rattle-hatch.loseText: It scrapes you raw and skitters off. You push on toward the booth.

concierge.name: The Concierge
concierge.blurb: Door with a ledger. Toll in Energy — unpaid becomes HP.
concierge.intent: TOLL DUE — taxes 1 Energy after your turn. If you spent it all, takes 3 HP instead. Then strikes.
concierge.winText: The ledger stamps PAID. The door swings. Spare Key drops into party stash.
concierge.loseText: ACCOUNT CLOSED. The Concierge wipes the party. Recap what you learned.
